scenarios.assumptions: Workers repeatedly fail the same dependency while valid tasks accumulate. What will you do and why?
scenarios.limitations: Constructed production interview prompt; exact frequency, ranking and company attribution are unverified.

concept-specificity.rationale: Applies Message Queue Fundamentals to dependency outage.

distinctness.rationale: Separate constraint/decision: A storage outage creates a retry storm. Add workers?

production-prompt.rationale: Prompt states a production failure or workload bound and asks for a justified response.

direct-answer.rationale: Reviewed action: Bound attempts and downstream concurrency, back off safely, preserve durable pending work and shed/defer new demand when capacity is exhausted

decision-costs.rationale: Reviewed cost/alternative: Users wait or receive rejection

follow-up.rationale: Reviewed trap: Extra workers cannot repair the unavailable dependency and can exhaust the remaining resources faster; recovery must fit a measured budget.
